articles.title: Bitcoin surges above $68,000, liquidating $1.4 billion shorts as Treasury buybacks boost risk appetite
articles.snippet: BTC rose about 6% while ether, solana and crypto stocks climbed after the Treasury doubled the size of its bond buybacks.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin and gold jump but rejected at key level as Treasury move pushes yields lower
articles.snippet: Led by Scott Bessent, the U.S. Treasury announced at least a doubling in the size of its long-dated bond buybacks.

articles.title: Robot maker Unitree’s IPO surges 600% , outpacing crypto traders’ premarket bets
articles.snippet: A Hyperliquid perp priced Unitree far above its IPO valuation before Shanghai trading began, but the robot maker’s first public trade still opened roughly 75% above crypto traders’ implied price.

articles.title: OCC head promises final GENIUS rules by November
articles.snippet: The US banking regulator released a 376‑page proposal in February, calling for public comment on rules to implement the stablecoin bill ahead of its January 2027 effective date.

articles.title: Standard Chartered analyst eyes $100K BTC as US Treasury doubles long-end buybacks
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s rebound toward $69,000 is gaining momentum as Geoff Kendrick points to improving liquidity conditions and a potential cycle bottom.
